verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The probe-controlled status and reset values are gated at both classify() interpolation sites with full-match, length-bounded vocabularies that exclude whitespace and Markdown/HTML metacharacters. Missing and malformed values remain fail-closed and diagnostically distinct, numeric reset epochs retain their supported rendering, and the capped/eligible decisions are unchanged. The self-tests exercise both capped-window branches, hostile full strings with conforming prefixes, the final rendered-body binding layer, accepted producer-shaped values, absent values, metacharacters, whitespace, booleans, and the 64-character boundary. The positive controls also prevent blanket redaction from passing vacuously. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is evident. This matches round 1's clean result, so progress is stagnant under the required comparison scale.
